Name: FarmerBeans' Cozy Farm Buildings for Alternative Textures - Premium too
Author: farmerbeans
Description:
[size=5][b]Alternative Textures: Cozy Farm Buildings
[/b][/size]
Adds textures for all the base-game Coops, Barns, as well for the Premium Coop, Premium Barn and the Winery from Stardew Valley Expanded. Buildings that were "paintable" can still be painted through the building menu at Robin's Shop. 

Requires Alternative Textures. 

Compatible with or without SVE. Compatible with Content Patcher, Happy Home Designer

[size=4][b]How to use Alternative Textures
[/b][/size]Buy the [b]paint bucket[/b] from robin, then "use" the paint bucket on any of the buildings listed above, then choose your desired texture. 

[size=4][b]Known Issues[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Currently there is a known issue with AT if [b]ANY object is overlapping the footprint[/b] of the building.  This is most commonly caused by[b] crafted paths/flooring[/b] underneath the building. The Paint bucket UI may show a red 🚫symbol or broken texture while painting and the texture will not apply correctly. Remove any paths or objects from under the building to restore the correct behavior.  (you may have to use a bomb or move the building if you can't reach the path to remove it).  You can replace the paths/items applying the texture.  This will not harm your game, but it is a little inconvenient.[/size]
[*][size=3][b]SVE's Grandpa's S[/b][b]hed[/b] is not technically a paintable object, so it is not included in this mod. The [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32013]Content Patcher version[/url]﻿ [i]does [/i]have Grandpa's shed, and is compatible with this mod. [/size]
[/list]
[b][size=5]Looking for the Content Patcher Version?
[/size][/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32014]Vanilla Buildings are here[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32013]SVE buildings are here[/url]. The CP versions are fully compatible with this mod. 

[size=5]More Farm Buildings Coming Soon[/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]Farmhouse[/size]
[*][size=3]Silo[/size]
[*][size=3]Sheds[/size]
[*][size=3]Cabins[/size]
[/list]

[size=5]Thank you so much for your feedback and support!  [/size]
